inline.use: Directional text inside prose or action labels

ui.use: Icon-like directional controls and compact navigation

display.use: Large directional composition and media artwork

semantics.↩: return, enter, undo only when context names it
semantics.↪: forward return or redo only when context names it

accessibility: If an arrow is the only visible control, its accessible name must state the action. Mark redundant decorative arrows aria-hidden=true.
